content_of_post_to_comment: 3 Hard Truths About Teaching in Public School Generally speaking, kids have little to no interest in learning your subject. If you want buy-in you have to exercise salesmanship. If you want your kids to actually remember a particular lesson. You’re going to have to teach that lesson more than once in a variety of ways. That life-changing lesson you taught your 3rd period class. The one where you had kids standing on desks reciting poetry? Yeah, that same lesson caused a fist fight in your 6th period class after lunch. There are no fool-proof plans.
comment: The hidden challenge may be that teaching is less about delivering a perfect lesson and more about building systems that survive different contexts, moods, and groups of students. Consistency might matter more than brilliance.
